mippify.gui.title: Mippify Settings
mippify.enableMod.tooltip: Controls whether Mippify is enabled. A game restart is required for full changes.
mippify.smoothing.tooltip: Smooths mipmaps by adjusting alpha cutout. Requires a game restart to apply.
mippify.fastEdge.tooltip: Optimizes the edge filtering method for cutout textures. Edge colors may become inaccurate.
